patches: source/xatlas/xatlas.cpp ClusteredCharts::mergeCharts (code/devtools/triflow/xatlas/xatlas-mergeCharts.patch, +65/-25): the boundary walk records the neighbours it touches and only those are visited and reset (not every chart id, with three per-chart arrays zeroed each time); a chart tested and merged with nothing is skipped until it or a neighbour changes (not re-tested after every merge); merged charts are compacted in one pass. The candidates, their order and every test are unchanged, so the atlas is the same.
